concerns.text: The plan assumes that cloning the five repositories (pandas, requests, scikit-learn, flask, django) will yield ≥500 valid (commit_message, doc_diff) pairs from the last two years, but no citation or empirical justification is provided that these repos contain enough documentation‑only changes to meet this quota. If the actual count falls short, FR‑001 and SC‑001 will be violated, breaking the research pipeline.
